--- theorem_first_run  (core/src/theorem.rs)
pub proof fn theorem_first_run(p: &Program, m: &Machine, heap0: Seq<HeapObj>, globals0: Seq<Value>)
    requires loaded(p, m, heap0, globals0),
    ensures
        m.inv(p),
        reaches(p.ap@, initial_state(p.ap@, heap0, globals0), m.g@),

--- theorem_next_run  (core/src/theorem.rs)
pub proof fn theorem_next_run(p: &Program, m0: &Machine, m1: &Machine, m2: &Machine, r: (usize, i64),
    s0: State2)
    requires
        m0.inv(p),
        reaches(p.ap@, s0, m0.g@),
        run_post(p, *m0, *m1, r),
        r.0 == RESULT_PREEMPTED || r.0 == RESULT_YIELDED,
        resumed(p, m1, m2),
    ensures
        m2.inv(p),
        reaches(p.ap@, s0, m2.g@),

--- lemma_heap_ext_grows  (spec/src/v2/sound_frames.rs)
pub proof fn lemma_heap_ext_grows(p: Program2, h: Seq<HeapObj>, h2: Seq<HeapObj>)
    requires heap_ext(p, h, h2),
    ensures heap_grows(h, h2),

--- lemma_good_mono  (spec/src/v2/sound_frames.rs)
pub proof fn lemma_good_mono(h: Seq<HeapObj>, h2: Seq<HeapObj>, v: Value)
    requires good(h, v), h.len() <= h2.len(),
    ensures good(h2, v),

--- lemma_below_upto  (spec/src/v2/sound_upto.rs)
pub proof fn lemma_below_upto(s: State2, s2: State2, fi: int)
    requires same_below(s, s2, fi), bases_ok(s),
    ensures same_upto(s, s2, fi, slots(s, fi)),

--- theorem_soundness  (spec/src/v2/theorem.rs)
pub proof fn theorem_soundness(p: Program2, c: Cert, trusted: bool, heap0: Seq<HeapObj>, globals0: Seq<Value>, s: State2)
    requires
        accepts(p, c, trusted),
        loaded_ok(p, c, heap0, globals0),
        reachable(p, heap0, globals0, s),
    ensures
        !(step(p, s) is Stuck),
        forall|s1: State2, module: u8, index: u16, o: Outcome2|
            step(p, s) == Outcome2::Primitive(s1, module, index) && #[trigger] completion(p, s1, module, index, o)
                ==> !(o is Stuck),
        machine_objects_ok(p, s),

--- theorem_initial  (spec/src/v2/theorem.rs)
pub proof fn theorem_initial(p: Program2, c: Cert, trusted: bool, heap0: Seq<HeapObj>, globals0: Seq<Value>)
    requires accepts(p, c, trusted), loaded_ok(p, c, heap0, globals0),
    ensures reachable(p, heap0, globals0, initial_state(p, heap0, globals0)),
        wf(p, c, initial_state(p, heap0, globals0)),

--- step_verified  (spec/src/exec_step.rs)
pub fn step_verified(p: &ExecProgram, s: &mut ExecState) -> (r: Option<ExecOutcome>)
    requires wf_program(p@), wf_state(old(s)@),
    ensures
        match r {
            Some(o) => matches(step(p@, old(s)@), o, final(s)@),
            None => final(s)@ == old(s)@,
        },

--- x_info  (spec/src/v2/check.rs)
pub fn x_info(p: &ExecProgram, m: usize) -> (r: MethodInfo)
    requires m < p.methods.len(),
    ensures r == info(pview2(p), m as int),

--- x_class_count  (spec/src/v2/check.rs)
pub fn x_class_count(p: &ExecProgram) -> (r: usize)
    ensures r as int == class_count(pview2(p)),

--- verify  (spec/src/v2/check.rs)
pub fn verify(p: &ExecProgram, c: &XCert, trusted: bool) -> (r: bool)
    ensures r == accepts(pview2(p), c@, trusted),

--- x_frame_height  (spec/src/v2/exec.rs)
pub fn x_frame_height(s: &ExecState) -> (r: i64)
    requires small(view2(s)), base(view2(s)) < 0x1_0000_0000_0000,
    ensures r as int == frame_height(view2(s)),

--- step_verified  (spec/src/v2/exec.rs)
pub fn step_verified(p: &ExecProgram, s: &mut ExecState) -> (r: Option<ExecOutcome2>)
    requires wf_exec_program2(p), wf_exec_state2(old(s)),
    ensures
        match r {
            Some(o) => matches2(step(pview2(p), view2(old(s))), o, view2(final(s))),
            None => view2(final(s)) == view2(old(s)),
        },

--- x_loaded_ok  (spec/src/v2/heap_check.rs)
pub fn x_loaded_ok(p: &ExecProgram, c: &XCert, heap: &Vec<ExecObj>, globals: &Vec<Value>) -> (r: bool)
    requires wf_program2(pview2(p)),
    ensures r == loaded_ok(pview2(p), c@, hview(heap), globals@),
